founder.title:
Born
*courtside*.
founder.lead: For years, amateur basketball made do without a dedicated tool. Coaches got by with loose sheets of paper or an Excel file. Clubs relied on memory.
founder.p1: SWEYL is the tool every amateur coach always wished they had.
founder.p2: Built with coaches and players on the court, who saw what was missing and refuse to let amateur sport stay tech's blind spot.
founder.p3: One app for the whole club, made for everyone who brings it to life every weekend.

different.q: Is it really different from a stats tool?
different.a: Stats are only part of it. SWEYL follows the whole life of the club: schedule, season, sharing.

price.a: Free for coaches and presidents. Players try it for a month, then choose. No card required to sign up.

statistician.a: No need. A bench player is enough, the app guides them step by step.

duration.q: How long does it take to record a game?
duration.a: The length of the game. Stats are entered live, there's nothing to catch up on afterwards.

mistakes.q: What if the stat keeper makes a mistake?
mistakes.a: Every play can be corrected during and after the game. The history stays accurate.

teams.q: Can a coach manage several teams?
teams.a: All your teams live in the same space, you switch from one to another in a single tap.

parents.q: Can my parents follow the game without an account?
parents.a: The live game is public: sharing a link is all it takes.

transfer.q: Does my history follow me if I change clubs?
transfer.a: Yes. Your player profile is unique, your stats travel with you.

devices.a: SWEYL installs from the browser on iPhone, Android and computer, and works like an app.

ffbb.a: A link is all it takes. Import and sync are automatic.

history.q: What happens to my past games?
history.a: Drop in your PDF game sheets. SWEYL extracts the stats and rebuilds your history in seconds.

onboarding.a: A demo, setting up your club, a few tests, and you're off. We're with you every step of the way.
